prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity conventional desktop photo archive application Home screen for Mazi, a signed-in group of eight friends. 1536x1024 landscape, straight screenshot without devices or presentation labels. The familiar photo library option, executed with exceptional clarity and precise photography, no 3D. Neutral off-white #FAFAF8 canvas, charcoal #252525 text, forest #345C49 active controls, crisp humanist sans. Fine borders, modest corner radii.
Slim top navigation: lowercase mazi left; Home active / Timeline / Search center; My Imports and group avatar right. Main heading 'Your shared memories' with a compact 'Add memories' button at right. Featured horizontal region below: large landscape candid photograph occupying left 65%, right information panel with title 'The night we missed the last ferry', 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos', 'Added by Deniz', and 'Open memory'. The photograph is synthetic friends laughing on a Mediterranean terrace at dusk, cobalt sea and warm table lights.
Below featured region a date heading 'Recently added' and a precise six-column photographic grid of ordinary shared moments: lake swim, city walk, birthday table, picnic, road trip, quiet Sunday. Captions on clean white below each image, legible dates. Flat image rectangles, no invented depth or decorative props, careful alignment and density. All controls immediately understandable. Bottom corner 'Demo memories'. No public sharing, publish gate, privacy selectors, marketing slogan, likes, notification counts, statistics, search field duplicated alongside Search nav, or secondary navigation at bottom. Make the product feel beautifully built even though its layout is intentionally familiar.
